_about: Public-domain George Thomas Stokes (1843-1898), professor of ecclesiastical history at Trinity College, Dublin, for the Word Hoard: Ireland and the Celtic Church, Ireland and the Anglo-Norman Church, The Acts of the Apostles (in the Expositor's Bible), and Some Worthies of the Irish Church. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 118 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

gtstokes-celtic-church: Ireland and the Celtic church : a history of Ireland from St. Patrick to the English conquest in 1172 (London : Hodder and Stoughton, 1886)
gtstokes-anglo-norman: Ireland and the Anglo-Norman Church, a history of Ireland and Irish Christianity from the Anglo-Norman Conquest to the dawn of the Reformation (London, Hodder, 1889)
gtstokes-acts-1: The Acts of the Apostles, in the Expositor's Bible (New York: A. C. Armstrong & Son, 1893)
gtstokes-worthies: Some worthies of the Irish Church : lectures delivered in the Divinity school of the University of Dublin (London : Hodder and Stoughton, 1900)

_excluded.gtstokes-pococke: Pococke's Tour in Ireland, which he only edited
